chunks.page_content: Meriwether Lewis and William Clark were explorers. Meriwether Lewis and William Clark carried out the Lewis and Clark Expedition. The Lewis and Clark Expedition took place from 1804 to 1806.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the geographical characteristics, location, historical significance, and visitor experience of Lewis and Clark Pass.
chunks.page_content: Lewis and Clark Pass can be accessed by a 1.5 mi trail. On a clear day, one can see Square Butte from Lewis and Clark Pass. Lewis and Clark Pass lies at the head of the drainage of the west flowing Blackfoot River. Meriwether Lewis crossed Lewis and Clark Pass on July 7, 1806. Lewis and Clark Pass is one of the places along the expedition's route that visitors may still encounter a grizzly bear. Meriwether Lewis crossed Lewis and Clark Pass with a party of nine men. Lewis and Clark Pass has an elevation of 6424 ft. Lewis and Clark Pass is one of the least visited passes today. Native people living in what today is Montana crossed over the continental divide at Lewis and Clark Pass. Lewis and Clark Pass is a mountain pass. Lewis and Clark Pass is the only roadless pass on the entire Lewis and Clark National Historic Trail. Lewis and Clark Pass was one of the most used continental divide passes prior to the pioneer era. The furrows left by travois at Lewis and Clark Pass are fading. Visitors will encounter Lewis and Clark Pass much as Meriwether Lewis did in 1806. Lewis and Clark Pass is in Montana. Lewis and Clark Pass was named for the expedition's two leaders, Lewis and William Clark. Furrows left by countless dog and horse travois that crossed Lewis and Clark Pass are still visible. Lewis and Clark Pass is in Lewis and Clark County. Meriwether Lewis crossed Lewis and Clark Pass on the return leg of the Lewis and Clark Expedition. Lewis and Clark Pass lies at the head of the drainage of the east flowing Dearborn River. Meriwether Lewis saw Square Butte from Lewis and Clark Pass in 1806. Lewis and Clark Pass is in the Helena National Forest. Lewis and Clark Pass is on the continental divide. Meriwether Lewis crossed Lewis and Clark Pass with his dog Seaman. The Continental Divide Trail traverses north and south through Lewis and Clark Pass.
